# Configuration reference

<!-- GENERATED by apps/api/scripts/gen_config_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every environment variable the software reads, generated from the settings classes. A test
fails if this file is stale. Regenerate with:

```bash
cd apps/api && .venv/Scripts/python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --write
```

Settings are read from the process environment and from `.env` in the working directory.
**Every risky capability defaults to off.** "Related gate" names an item in
[`docs/legal/release-gates.md`](../legal/release-gates.md); turning a switch on does not clear
that gate. Callback ranges are hard ceilings: values above them are rejected at startup.


## Core

| Variable | Type | Default | Range | Who may change | Related gate | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CALLSHIELD_ENVIRONMENT` | str | `dev` | - | operator (.env) | - | Deployment mode: dev, test or prod. |
| `CALLSHIELD_DB_URL` | str | `sqlite:///./callshield.db` | - | operator (.env) | - | SQLAlchemy database URL. SQLite for local use, Postgres for real. |
| `CALLSHIELD_DB_ECHO` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | - | Log SQL statements (debug only; may expose data). |
| `CALLSHIELD_OUTBOUND_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | G1,G2,G4,G5 | Master switch for any outbound call. |
| `CALLSHIELD_LIVE_STT_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | G3 | Live speech-to-text on calls. |
| `CALLSHIELD_AI_OUTBOUND_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | G1,G4,G5 | AI voice on outbound calls. |
| `CALLSHIELD_COMMUNITY_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | counsel | Community signal sharing (not built). |
| `CALLSHIELD_FILING_SUBMISSION_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | counsel | Programmatic agency filing. |
| `CALLSHIELD_JWT_SECRET` | secret | `insecure dev placeholder` | - | operator (.env) | - | Signs login tokens. Must be random and private. |
| `CALLSHIELD_JWT_ALGORITHM` | str | `HS256` | - | operator (.env) | - | JWT signing algorithm. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` | int | `3600` | - | operator (.env) | - | Login token lifetime in seconds. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ALLOW_BOOTSTRAP` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | - | Allow creating more tenants through the open endpoint. |
| `CALLSHIELD_OIDC_ISSUER` | str \| None | `(unset)` | - | operator (.env) | - | OIDC issuer (not implemented). |
| `CALLSHIELD_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | str \| None | `(unset)` | - | operator (.env) | - | OIDC client id (not implemented). |
| `CALLSHIELD_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | secret | `(unset)` | - | operator (.env) | - | OIDC client secret (not implemented). |
| `CALLSHIELD_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | secret | `(empty)` | - | operator (.env) | - | HMAC secret that signs provider webhooks. |
| `CALLSHIELD_WEBHOOK_REPLAY_WINDOW_SECONDS` | int | `300` | - | operator (.env) | - | How old a signed webhook may be. |
| `CALLSHIELD_WEBHOOK_RECEIPT_RETENTION_DAYS` | int | `30` | 1- | operator (.env) | - | Days to keep replay nonces. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS` | list[str] | `[]` | - | operator (.env) | - | JSON list of browser origins allowed; never '*'. |
| `CALLSHIELD_FILING_UNKNOWN_VERIFY_AFTER_HOURS` | int | `24` | 1- | operator (.env) | - | Hours before an UNKNOWN filing asks you to verify it. |
| `CALLSHIELD_MAX_CALL_SECONDS` | int | `600` | - | operator (.env) | - | Hard cap on a single call's length. |
| `CALLSHIELD_OUTBOUND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` | int | `900` | - | operator (.env) | - | Minimum gap between outbound attempts. |
| `CALLSHIELD_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_CASE_PER_DAY` | int | `3` | - | operator (.env) | - | Outbound attempts per case per day. |
| `CALLSHIELD_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_TENANT_PER_DAY` | int | `10` | - | operator (.env) | - | Outbound attempts per tenant per day. |
| `CALLSHIELD_RETENTION_METADATA_DAYS` | int | `90` | - | operator (.env) | - | Retention for call metadata (design default). |
| `CALLSHIELD_RETENTION_RECORDING_DAYS` | int | `30` | - | operator (.env) | - | Retention for recordings (design default). |
| `CALLSHIELD_RETENTION_TRANSCRIPT_DAYS` | int | `30` | - | operator (.env) | - | Retention for transcripts (design default). |
| `CALLSHIELD_RETENTION_CASE_DAYS` | int | `365` | - | operator (.env) | - | Retention for cases (design default). |

## Callback flow

| Variable | Type | Default | Range | Who may change | Related gate | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_CALLBACK_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | true/false | user (dashboard), within range | G1-G5 | Enable the automated callback flow. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_CALLBACK_WINDOW_HOURS` | int | `72` | 1-168 | user (dashboard), within range | - | How long after an inbound call a callback may be requested. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_LISTEN_WINDOW_SECONDS` | int | `10` | 0-10 | user (dashboard), within range | G3 | Seconds of listening before disclosure. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_BARE_GREETING_DISCLOSE_MS` | int | `1500` | 500-3000 | operator | - | Silence before disclosure after a bare greeting. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_INBOUND` | int | `2` | 1-2 | user (dashboard), within range | - | Callbacks per inbound call (ceiling 2). |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_NUMBER_30D` | int | `2` | 1-2 | user (dashboard), within range | - | Callbacks per number in 30 days (ceiling 2). |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_USER_DAY` | int | `5` | 1-5 | user (dashboard), within range | - | Callbacks per user per day (ceiling 5). |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_MAX_QUESTION_TURNS` | int | `4` | 1-4 | operator | - | Scripted question turns per callback. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_MAX_CALL_SECONDS` | int | `120` | 30-120 | operator | - | Maximum callback duration. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_OUTBOUND_RECORDING` | bool | `false` | true/false | chosen per request | G3 | Record callbacks (needs a recording notice). |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_REMOTE_AI_PROCESSING` | bool | `false` | locked: false | nobody (locked) | - | Locked to false: no remote AI on callbacks. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_ALLOWED_ATTESTATION` | str | `A` | locked: A | nobody (locked) | G2 | Locked to A: only A-attested inbound calls. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_DISCLOSURE_TEMPLATE_ID` | str | `v1` | - | operator (.env) | - | Which built-in disclosure script is spoken. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_HMAC_SECRET` | secret | `insecure dev placeholder` | - | operator (.env) | - | Key that signs callback authorizations. |
| `CALLSHIELD_CALLBACK_STORAGE_ROOT` | str | `./var/callback` | - | operator (.env) | - | Directory for callback artifacts. |

## Asterisk telephony (ARI)

| Variable | Type | Default | Range | Who may change | Related gate | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | G5 | Run the Asterisk ARI telephony runner. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_ARI_URL` | str | `http://127.0.0.1:8088` | - | operator (.env) | - | ARI base URL, no credentials, no /ari suffix. Keep it on localhost. Legacy CALLSHIELD_ARI_URL is accepted as a fallback. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_ARI_USERNAME` | str | `callshield` | - | operator (.env) | - | ARI user (legacy fallback: CALLSHIELD_ARI_USERNAME). |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_ARI_PASSWORD` | secret | `(empty)` | - | operator (.env) | - | ARI password; must equal ari.conf (legacy fallback: CALLSHIELD_ARI_PASSWORD). |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_APP_NAME` | str | `callshield` | - | operator (.env) | - | Inbound Stasis application name (legacy fallback: CALLSHIELD_ARI_APP). |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_OUTBOUND_APP_NAME` | str | `callshield-out` | - | operator (.env) | - | Stasis application for callback legs. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_EXTERNAL_MEDIA_HOST` | str | `127.0.0.1` | - | operator (.env) | - | Host Asterisk sends RTP to. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_EXTERNAL_MEDIA_BIND` | str | `127.0.0.1` | - | operator (.env) | - | Local address CallShield binds RTP on. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_EXTERNAL_MEDIA_PORT` | int | `4000` | 1024-65000 | operator (.env) | - | First RTP port CallShield uses. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_EXTERNAL_MEDIA_PORT_COUNT` | int | `100` | 1-2000 | operator (.env) | - | Number of RTP ports in the range. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_CODEC` | Literal['ulaw', 'slin16'] | `ulaw` | - | operator (.env) | - | Media codec: ulaw (8 kHz) or slin16. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_TRUNK_ENDPOINT` | str | `trunk` | - | operator (.env) | - | PJSIP endpoint name of the trunk (used by dial and doctor). |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_DIAL_FORMAT` | str | `PJSIP/{number}@{trunk}` | - | operator (.env) | - | Outbound dial string template; must contain {number}. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_DIAL_STRIP_PLUS` | bool | `false` | true/false | operator (.env) | - | Strip the leading + when dialing. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_USER_DIAL_FORMAT` | str | `PJSIP/{number}@{trunk}` | - | operator (.env) | - | Dial string template for ringing the user. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_VOICEMAIL_CONTEXT` | str | `callshield-route` | - | operator (.env) | - | Dialplan context for the voicemail hand-off. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_VOICEMAIL_EXTENSION` | str | `voicemail` | - | operator (.env) | - | Dialplan extension for the voicemail hand-off. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_FALLBACK_CONTEXT` | str | `callshield-route` | - | operator (.env) | - | Dialplan context for ring-the-user fallback. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_FALLBACK_EXTENSION` | str | `ring-user` | - | operator (.env) | - | Dialplan extension for ring-the-user fallback. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_RING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | int | `45` | 5-120 | operator (.env) | - | Seconds to ring before giving up. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_MAX_CALL_SECONDS_CAP` | int | `120` | 1-120 | operator (.env) | - | Hard cap on a screened or callback call. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_SCREENING_NO_SPEECH_SECONDS` | float | `8.0` | 1.0-30.0 | operator (.env) | - | Silence before screening gives up. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_RECONNECT_MIN_SECONDS` | float | `0.5` | 0- | operator (.env) | - | Minimum ARI reconnect backoff. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_RECONNECT_MAX_SECONDS` | float | `30.0` | 0- | operator (.env) | - | Maximum ARI reconnect backoff. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_RECORDING_DIR` | pathlib.Path \| None | `(unset)` | - | operator (.env) | - | Callback recordings (post-disclosure only); unset = none. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_HEALTH_HOST` | str | `127.0.0.1` | - | operator (.env) | - | Runner health endpoint bind address. |
| `CALLSHIELD_ASTERISK_HEALTH_PORT` | int | `8089` | 0-65535 | operator (.env) | - | Runner health endpoint port (0 disables). |
